newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK handbag maker seen in HK$200 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK handbag maker seen in HK$200 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Hong Kong-based handbag maker and cardboard producer Lee and Man Holdings Ltd is expected to raise about HK$200 million in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in April, market sources said on Thursday.
Sources said the issue was expected to be priced at a price/earnings multiple of about seven times but said listing details were unavailable.
"Handbags account for about 60 percent of the company's sales. Thirty percent comes from cardboard and 10 percent from the production of cassette tapes," one source said.
Proceeds from the issue are expected to be used mainly to buy new machinery for the expansion of cardboard production capacity, sources said.
Amsteel Securities and Citicorp are expected to be the sponsors of the issue, they said.
Amsteel and Citicorp officials are not immediately available for comment.
